systems.system: National number (12 digits, granted from birth)
systems.owner: National Number Project with the Civil Status Authority

systems.system: National database (basic citizen data, completed with ten-print, iris, photograph and signature from passport and identity card applications)
systems.owner: Civil Status Authority and the National Number Project

systems.system: Grant of the national number from birth on the person's data in the civil registry (Article 4)

note: The law defines the national number and the national database and names the civil registry database only as the source they complement; it does not say how or where a birth or death is entered, so the civil registry database is unclassified and gives no fact.
